Our Foundation

Our Purpose

🎯

Objective

ILBSL aims to empower Nepal’s underserved communities by fostering self-reliance and independence, contributing to rural social development through self-employment and enhanced social awareness.

👁️

Vision

To build a sustainable and inclusive society by promoting economic independence among Nepal’s marginalized populations, primarily through self-employment and social empowerment.

🚀

Mission

To provide sustainable microfinance services to needy and underserved families across Nepal, supporting their journey toward financial stability and growth.

Strategic Goals

✔ Empower deprived households via technology-driven solutions.
✔ Institutional excellence with motivated staff.
✔ Formalize the informal financial sector.
✔ Promote financial literacy and inclusion.
✔ Support entrepreneurship and SMEs.
✔ Strengthen rural economies.

Chief Executive Officer

Our mission at ILBSL is to bridge the gap in financial inclusion for Nepal's rural and marginalized communities. In an era of evolving microfinance landscapes, we face challenges like inflation and shifting regulations with resilience and strategic foresight.

We are currently prioritizing digitization, leveraging mobile banking and digital lending platforms to ensure our services are seamless and accessible. Our commitment remains rooted in Digital Excellence, ESG principles, and the continuous development of our talent pool.

By expanding our product portfolio and branch network, we aim to bring prosperity to every household we serve. We extend our deepest gratitude to the Government of Nepal, Nepal Rastra Bank, our Board, and our dedicated staff for their unwavering support in this journey toward community empowerment.
